title: GabberH0FiniteSection
statement: Let $X$ be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and let $i:Z\to X$ be a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion]. Suppose that for every sheaf of sets $G$ on the underlying Zariski space of $X$, the canonical restriction $\Gamma(X,G)\to\Gamma(Z,i^{-1}_{\mathrm{Zar}}G)$ is bijective, with topological inverse image as in [def-weil-pbc-topological-inverse-image]. Suppose also that for every finite morphism $h:X'\to X$ [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], the same assertion holds for the base-changed closed immersion $i':Z'=Z\times_XX'\to X'$ and every Zariski sheaf of sets on $X'$. For every sheaf of sets $F$ on $X_{\rm et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets] and every $t\in\Gamma(Z,i^{-1}_{\rm et}F)$, there exist a finite surjective $h:X\prime\to X$ [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism, def-weil-surjective-morphism] and $s\prime\in\Gamma(X\prime,h^{-1}_{\rm et}F)$ such that, with $Z\prime=Z\times_X X\prime$, $h_Z:Z\prime\to Z$ and $i\prime:Z\prime\to X\prime$, $c_{i,h_Z}(h_Z^*t)=c_{h,i\prime}(i\prime^*s\prime)$ after transport along $h_Z\circ i=i\prime\circ h$ [def-pc-fibre-product, lem-weil-pbc-sets-etale-inverse-image-composition-units]. No equality of the two projection pullbacks is asserted.

proof.text: The surjective part of hFinite, specialized to h and G, gives a∈G(Xprime) with unit(a)=sigma. Choose sPrime=lift(a). Apply compare to this equality, reverse the sigma equation, and compose with the unit equation to get the asserted restriction equation. The finite and surjective instances of h supply the required witnesses.
